tasks.title: Save and reload an owner-private note
tasks.outcome: Save and reload an owner-private note

acceptance.criterion: An authenticated user can save a note with a client and follow-up date, then find it after reloading.
acceptance.verification: Exercise create, reload, and read in a browser acceptance test.

acceptance.criterion: Another user cannot list or retrieve the owner’s notes.
acceptance.verification: Use two test users and verify list isolation and denied direct-ID access.

tasks.title: Find upcoming follow-ups in date order
tasks.outcome: Find upcoming follow-ups in date order

acceptance.criterion: The upcoming list places an earlier follow-up before a later one.
acceptance.verification: Create two dated notes and assert their displayed order.
